scope: Full periodic 4x4x4, 37 original atoms, 111 ionic Cartesian coordinates per cell, plus ONE canonical global q0 field. Electrons are explicitly held at the original prepared state. This is a required CONTROL, not completion or replacement of joint electronic/ionic/field dynamics.
scalar: H_control = sum_R (p_R-Z E^T a)^T M^-1 (p_R-Z E^T a)/2 - sum_R F^T u_R + sum_RS u_R^T [C_frozen(R-S)+delta_R,S deltaC] u_S/2 + sum_R u_R^T T E^T a + N ell^T E^T a + N a^T E contact E^T a/2 + Pi^T Pi/(2 Mfield). The unchanged frozen electronic scalar constant is omitted, not inferred.

normalization.fourier: x_q = sum_R exp(-2pi i q.R) x_R / sqrt(N); C(q)=sum_R exp(-2pi i q.R) C(R)
normalization.affine_gradient: (-sqrt(N) F,0,N E ell,0) at Gamma only
normalization.ordered_covariance: W_q(t,s)=S_q(t) W0_q S_minus_q(s)^T, no dagger; real-space inverse Fourier uses 1/N
normalization.preparation: Reuse saved local_ordered, omega_ry and masses_ry, and saved joint field ordered_covariance verbatim. Original tensor product, centered sudden release, not coupled equilibrium.
normalization.mean_CCR: i/N for cell means, versus canonical i for orthonormal Gamma variables

kick.local: One original atom Cartesian canonical momentum displacement sqrt(2 M omega) at selected cell: added initial energy omega Ry, a coherent displacement rather than a one-phonon number state.
kick.common: Identical displacement divided by sqrt(N) in every cell: equal TOTAL initial added energy omega Ry.
kick.covariance: Both coherent displacements preserve the baseline connected covariance; no extra quantum noise invented.

outputs.inputs.json: Authenticated settled inputs, current source bindings, original atom/cell/coordinate identities, raw coefficient/preparation defects, explicit times and kick, interpretation limits.
outputs.time-NNNN.npz: Full all-atom/all-cell baseline canonical mean ions and global field; local/common kick mean deltas; ordered equal-time and two-time spatial readout blocks from every cell to kick cell for selected original atom coordinate (u,p); two-time commutators; field equal-/two-time covariance; ion-field two-time covariance.
outputs.time-NNNN.json: Completed array binding/shapes, times, all three scenario energy/commutator/symplectic/reality/Hermiticity diagnostics. Emitted immediately per completed time.
outputs.result.json: Final completed-time manifest. Earlier complete time receipts survive an interrupted later time. No restart/resume claim.
outputs.capacity: Explicit total byte capacity; arrays outside repository; no full real-space 14208-square allocation. Selected readouts do not truncate internal atom/cell dynamics.
outputs.energy: Complex mean and covariance energies plus drift relative to exact t=0 product state. No absolute electronic scalar claim.

oracle.independent: SymPy differentiation of the real-cell homogeneous scalar, exact three-cell Fourier pairing, and separately assembled dense real-space SciPy exponential with affine source.
checks: Gamma sqrt(N), N and p-Za blocks
orthonormal q/-q and per-cell-mean CCR scaling
ordered CCR and paired symplectic conservation
raw complex coefficient retention and exposed Hermiticity defect
oracle.execution_status: Not executed by source-construction worker; Root owns independent oracle and actual saved-input smoke. No passed evidence inferred.
